title: start_spec persisted-output path is outside moeb read_file allowed roots, forcing Read tool fallback
description: When start_spec output exceeds the tool result limit, the kernel saves overflow content to C:\Users\Simeon\.claude\projects\... which is outside moeb's allowed roots for absolute-path reads (project root and OS temp directory). The agent cannot access this file via read_file or read_file_range and must fall back to the native Read tool, violating moeb-tool-origin compliance. This pattern will recur on every large start_spec or start_run invocation.
proposed_resolution: Change the persisted-output file path in start_spec and start_run to write under the OS temp directory (e.g. %TEMP% on Windows, $TMPDIR on Unix) so moeb's read_file_range with absolute: true can access it without requiring external tool fallback.
